profile.workload: generated slot-1 sample with held Trig 1 and all eight TCG helpers enabled

selected_loop.role: bounded saturated-fractional two-output handoff mix stage

transactional_candidate.implementation: Eight saturated fractional MAC operations, one intermediate accumulator clear, and two transactional output stores per iteration.

conclusion: With all eight helpers enabled, the deterministic handoff leaf retains 953,600 guest instructions per 100 services. A largest remaining fixed loop has 160 ordered memory events per call, and its native replay plus transactional reconstruction match all 35 registers and 640 touched bytes at two cursor positions without fallback.
next_gate: Promote mix32c to a ninth guarded direct-state TCG helper and measure its exact incremental reduction.
